reason: D1-5 edits schemas/batch.py, schemas/evidence.py and tools/batch_result.py, all inside evaluator 1.6.0's hashed boundary. The tree therefore matches no published evaluator until this phase is frozen, and that is the truth rather than a problem to be silenced: a manifest regenerated at every intermediate commit would be a published file edited repeatedly, which is the governance failure this project has already recorded three times.
version_rule: Decided by eval/aggregation_behavior.py --compare against eval/baselines/aggregation_behavior_baseline.json, frozen at f2adc5ea1fd5384ce97716a0d282b74651557b8f. Identical behaviour vectors -> 1.6.1. Any difference in status, value, chosen object, verified scope, applied axes, component counts or refusal stage -> 1.7.0.
on_freeze: run eval/aggregation_behavior.py --compare and record the outcome
generate the manifest for the version that outcome implies
publish registry_v4 authorising safe_sum_v5 with it
pin both in docs/acceptance/gate_versions.md and tests/test_contract_pins.py
verify readiness with the post-commit 40-character commit
note: While this file exists no run is release-eligible, because evaluator_readiness raises on a manifest that does not describe the code. That is intended: nothing produced mid-phase may be published.
